name: profile_sweep
description: Manual comparison helper for running multiple checked-in Glock profiles against one consistent target. It is for side-by-side operator review, not automated gameplay validation.

steps.name: baseline
steps.operatorNote: Use this as the reference pass before comparing tighter or more mobile tuning.

steps.name: cs_tight
steps.operatorNote: Focus on deliberate tap-fire and one careful headshot attempt against the same target state.

steps.name: cs_mobile
steps.operatorNote: Compare moving-shot behavior against the baseline and tighter passes.
